property_summary: For any call to multiplicate with msg.value >= c.balance before the call, the call either reverts or c's balance afterwards equals c.balance_before + msg.value - c.balance_before = msg.value, so a successful multiplicate with sufficient msg.value cannot leave c holding less than the sent amount.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `multiplicate(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
